找到关键问题了！看 diff 第 895 行：

```
/* SKIPPED: uart_hal_set_sclk hangs on P4 shared register */
```

`uart_hal_set_sclk` 仍然被跳过了！ 没有设置时钟源，UART RX 中断不会工作。
在 WSL 里检查：

```
grep -n "set-sclk" ~/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_serial.c
```

如果看到 `SKIPPED`，需要取消跳过：

```
# 看 esp_setup 函数里的 set-sclk 部分
sed -n '390,420p' ~/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_serial.c
```

把输出贴给我。这是codex的分析ty@localhost:/mnt/c/WINDOWS/system32$ grep -n "set-sclk" ~/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_serial.c
401:      ets_printf("ES:SETUP:10 set-sclk\n");
ty@localhost:/mnt/c/WINDOWS/system32$

`sclk` 修复丢了！grep 只找到 debug print，没找到 `uart_hal_set_sclk`。之前的 Python 替换可能没成功。验证一下：

```bash
sed -n '399,410p' ~/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_serial.c
```

如果看到 `SKIPPED` 注释，需要重新修复。两件事一起做：

```bash
cd ~/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif

# 修复 sclk
python3 -c "
with open('esp_serial.c', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'uart_hal_set_sclk hangs on P4' in line:
        lines[i] = '      uart_hal_set_sclk(priv->hal, UART_SCLK_DEFAULT);\n'
    if 'set-sclk-SKIPPED' in line:
        lines[i] = ''
with open('esp_serial.c', 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(lines)
print('Fixed')
"

# 修复 esp_board_initialize
sed -i 's|// esp_board_initialize(); // SKIPPED.*|esp_board_initialize();|' ~/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/chip/esp32p4/esp_startup.c

# 验证
grep -n "set-sclk\|SKIPPED" ~/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_serial.c
grep -n "esp_board_initialize" ~/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/chip/esp32p4/esp_startup.c

# 编译
cd ~/nuttx
make clean && make -j2 > build.log 2>&1 && echo "OK" || tail -30 build.log
```

编译成功后烧录测试。

关键发现！`board_late_initialize()` 是从 `nx_bringup.c:332` 调用的，不是从 `esp_start.c`。`esp_board_initialize()` 是另一回事。

`ES:14f board-init-SKIPPED` 只是残留的 debug 信息——`esp_board_initialize()` 实际已经在执行了（行 542 已取消注释）。

真正的 `board_late_initialize()` 在 `nx_start()` → `nx_bringup()` 里调用。配置没问题。试试彻底重编译：

```bash
cd ~/nuttx
make distclean
./tools/configure.sh esp32p4-function-ev-board:nsh
echo "CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=y" >> .config
make olddefconfig
make -j2 > build.log 2>&1 && echo "OK" || tail -30 build.log
```

编译成功后烧录测试。`distclean` 确保所有配置依赖的代码重新编译。

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: nx_create_initthread
 *
 * Description:
 *   Execute the board initialization function (if so configured) and start
 *   the application initialization thread.  This will be done either on the
 *   thread of execution of the caller or on a separate thread of execution
 *   if so configured.

 * Input Parameters:

 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   None
 *

static inline void nx_create_initthread(void)
{
#ifdef CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE

  /* Do the board/application initialization on a separate thread of
   * execution.

  pid = nxthread_create("AppBringUp", TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL,

                        NULL, CONFIG_BOARD_INITTHREAD_STACKSIZE,
                        nx_start_task, NULL, environ);
  DEBUGASSERT(pid > 0);
  UNUSED(pid);

  nx_start_application();
#endif
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: nx_create_initthread
 *
 * Description:
 *   Execute the board initialization function (if so configured) and start
 *   the application initialization thread.  This will be done either on the
 *   thread of execution of the caller or on a separate thread of execution
 *   if so configured.

static inline void nx_create_initthread(void)
{
#ifdef CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE

  /* Do the board/application initialization on a separate thread of
   * execution.

  nx_start_application();

### 项目概述
把 openvela（小米开源 NuttX RTOS）移植到 ESP32-P4 Function EV-Board。openvela 官方只支持 ESP32-S3/C3/C6 等旧芯片，ESP32-P4 是全新芯片，官方没有适配。
